review.summary: Both round-1 findings are fixed and the branch has no new findings. ADR-014 and the Forecasting domain doc now state that request validation of manual seasonal periods (non-blank metric keys, periods of at least 2) applies for every selection, even when a period is ignored, which matches the request schema and the existing 422 wording for model selection. The phrase implying a history check is removed. The Work Limit paragraph is re-wrapped. The round-2 change touches only these two passages, stays consistent with TASK-063B and TASK-063C, and the branch remains documentation-only with no code, migration, API schema or frontend change. The record validator passed.
